summary: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide names Milwaukee 2527-21, 2727-20, 2727-21HD and 6215 on their own lines, each with one chain: pitch, gauge, bar length and drive links. A separate line that only says "M18" is not used here, because it does not name a saw. The 2826-20 top-handle saw is not in that guide. Its page uses Milwaukee's operator's manual: .325" low profile, .043", 12" and 14". The 2727-21HD is the same Oregon R56 line as the 2727-20, so it redirects there.
